{"metadata":{"description":"English ｜ 简体中文","id":"gh:1444431205","install_available":true,"language":"HTML","name":"comfy-png-inspector","slug":"zzcyydshhh/comfy-png-inspector","topics":["comfyui","dsh-plugin","png-metadata","stable-diffusion"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"﻿**English** ｜ 简体中文"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ComfyUI Params Inspector"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**One PNG is a full recipe.** Drop a ComfyUI image on the page and you get the workflow that produce"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"d it, the whole LoRA chain, and every sampler setting — export it as-is, or pour those parameters in"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"to your own template and get a fresh workflow back."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A single page you open by double-clicking `index.html`. No dependencies, no uploads: images never le"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ave your machine and nothing touches the network."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Every filename, model name, LoRA name and prompt in the screenshot is synthetic demo data, unrelat"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ed to any real asset. The UI itself is in Simplified Chinese."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does, in thirty seconds"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| What you want | What you get |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| "How was this image made?" | Drop the PNG (or a whole `output` folder) → LoRA order and strengths,"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" seed / steps / CFG / sampler, base model, CLIP, VAE, both prompts |
| "I want to reproduce that res"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ult" | Click **export this image's workflow JSON** → a `.workflow.json` you can drop back onto a Com"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"fyUI canvas |
| "The PNG has parameters but no canvas graph" | Load a template workflow → **rebuild "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"from template** → every parameter (including the full LoRA chain) is poured in and a new workflow is"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" written out |
| "I need the parameters for a few hundred old images" | Export CSV / JSON, or batch-"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"pack every workflow into a zip |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Four things you think you can see, but can't"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **On the canvas ≠ in the run.** The demo image has `#91` and `#92` sitting right there — both `mo"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"de: 4` (bypassed), absent from the execution graph entirely. They get their own list here: *present "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"but not part of the render*.
2. **Reading the prompt directly gives you an empty string.** `CLIPText"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"Encode.text` is usually blank because the text arrives over a **link** (the output of `ZhPromptEnhan"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ce`, say). The tool walks the link to its source and names it: `CLIPTextEncode#4.text[slot 0] ← ZhPr"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"omptEnhance#79.text[slot 0]`.
3. **The negative prompt may be computed at runtime.** Slot 1 of an en"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"hancer is generated on the spot and never stored in the PNG. It is marked *generated at runtime* ins"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"tead of passing the enhancer's input off as the result.
4. **Parameters are scattered across dozens "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"of nodes.** Seventeen LoRAs chained together, each at its own strength — the tool climbs back from `"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"KSampler.model` and lists them in true execution order."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Browse**: pick a folder (recursive) / drop a folder / drop single PNGs. Inline thumbnails in the"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" list, a 212px preview that opens full-size in the detail pane.
- **Parameters**: seed, steps, CFG, "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"sampler / scheduler, denoise, latent, base model, CLIP (with type), VAE, save prefix, pre-sampler pa"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"tches (`ModelSamplingAuraFlow`, `CFGNorm`, …).
- **LoRA chain**: execution order plus strength, draw"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"n as a zero-centred slider (green positive, red negative), copyable as one line per LoRA.
- **Prompt"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s**: link resolution with slot annotations, expandable and copyable.
- **Search**: filename / LoRA n"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ame / prompt body. `Ctrl+K` to focus, `↑` `↓` to move.
- **Export**: parameter table as CSV (UTF-8 B"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"OM, opens cleanly in Excel) and as JSON.
- **Workflow export**: emit `.workflow.json` verbatim, or z"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ip a whole batch.
- **Template rebuild**: use an existing workflow as a template, pour the parsed pa"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"rameters in, get a new workflow. The template is deep-cloned and never written back.
- **DeepSeek Ha"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"rness plugin**: the same parser ships as a DSH bundle exposing `comfy_png_inspect` to the model."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Open **`comfy-png-inspector.html`** (Chrome / Edge 103+, `DecompressionStream` required) and drag yo"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ur ComfyUI `output` folder into the window."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- The `index.html` at the repo root is a one-line redirect kept for GitHub Pages; opening it offline"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" lands on the app too.
- The UI is **bilingual (Chinese / English)**: switch with `中文 / EN` in the t"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"op bar, the choice is remembered, and the default follows your browser language.
- Force a language "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"with the URL: `comfy-png-inspector.html?lang=en` (or `?lang=zh`)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Reproducing a workflow: two modes, don't mix them up"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"After selecting an image the detail pane offers two buttons. The difference is how much data the fil"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"cting an image the detail pane offers two buttons. The difference is how much data the file carries:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| | Export verbatim | Rebuild from template |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Button | Export this image's workflow JSON | Rebuild from template |
| Needs | A `workflow` chunk "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"inside the PNG | Any canvas workflow loaded as a template |
| Result | The exact canvas from the mom"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ent of generation — node positions, links, bypass state | The template's layout, with the parsed par"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ameters poured in |
| Best for | Straight reproduction, most reliable | API-only PNGs, or mapping ba"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ck onto the template you use today |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"1. **PNG chunk parsing**: reads `tEXt` / `zTXt` / `iTXt`; `zTXt` and compressed `iTXt` are inflated "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"with `DecompressionStream('deflate')` (zlib stream).
2. **Chain tracing**: start at `KSampler.model`"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" and follow `inputs.model` backwards, bucketing by node class (`LoraLoader*` = slider, `CFGNorm` / `"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ModelSampling*` = pre-sampler patch). Stops at `UNETLoader` / `CheckpointLoaderSimple`, then reverse"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"s into execution order.
3. **Bypass detection**: purely from `workflow.nodes[].mode` — `4` = bypass,"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" `2` = mute. These nodes are absent from the API graph, which is exactly why "on canvas" ≠ "in the r"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"un".
4. **Prompt resolution**: a string `text` is used as-is; a `[node_id, slot]` ref walks the link"},{"id":"p23s8","text":" to its source. Slot ≠ 0 means the value is produced at runtime, so it is not treated as a literal.
"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"5. **Template rebuild**: deep-clone the template → strip its LoRA nodes and links → append new nodes"},{"id":"p23s10","text":" in parsed order and chain them → rewire the tail into the original consumer → self-check."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- PNG only. ComfyUI metadata lives in PNG chunks; jpg / webp have none.
- Re-saving through a screen"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"shot tool, an IM app, or Photoshop drops the `tEXt` chunk — the UI will say "no ComfyUI metadata".
-"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" Under `file://` the browser will not let JavaScript scan a directory, so you must pick or drop once"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" per session.
- Rebuild is bounded by **the node classes present in the template**: a node class in "},{"id":"p25s5","text":"the PNG but not in the template will not be invented (LoRA nodes are the exception — recreated from "},{"id":"p25s6","text":"the parsed count). Read the change list before exporting.
- The zip writer is store-only (no compres"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"sion) to stay dependency-free; a few hundred workflows land in the low tens of MB."}],"truncated":true}
